$comment: Round-quality scorecard (#1220 PR 3). One entry per closed improvement track or A2AD round wave. Metrics are the feedback loop for guardpack/process changes: carryOverCount = deliverables that had to be re-tracked in a follow-up issue; falseFindingCount = audit/verification findings later corrected as wrong; reworkIssueCount = issues opened solely to redo or complete previously-closed work; legacyIncompleteCloses = checklist-incomplete completed-closes observed (one-time baseline from the first closeout-hygiene run). Validated fail-closed by scripts/check-round-quality-scorecard.mjs. Counts only — no personal identifiers, no private channels.
